title: Ark moved from Axum to Lake Ziway during the Italian occupation
place_text: Axum to an island on Lake Ziway, Ethiopia

tellings.quote: um the Ethiopians say that they took the ark out of Axum. Uh and they took it to another place of safekeeping.

plain: Ethiopians say that during the Italian occupation of their country, from 1935 to 1941, they took the Ark of the Covenant out of the ancient city of Axum and hid it for safekeeping on an island in Lake Ziway. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this as what the Ethiopians themselves say. If it is true, the Ark from the Bible survived and was moved to keep it from the invaders.
